claims.text: The deep learning methods investigated for hate speech detection include Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs), and FastText.
CNNs were used to leverage their effectiveness in sentiment classification, while LSTMs were employed to capture long-range dependencies in tweets.
FastText was utilized for its ability to update word vectors during training, allowing for task-specific fine-tuning.
